verdict.rationale: Smithery's archived token-scoping docs described service tokens limited to connections where metadata.userId matches a specific end user, which would have covered this story. Smithery's own shutdown notice says Connect, accounts, API keys, the CLI and the SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that it remains only a non-proxied registry. The product therefore no longer delivers per-end-user connected accounts or scoped tokens.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can maintain separate connected accounts and scoped tokens per end user of my product, so each user's agent acts only on that user's credentials
